rows.grounds: compound of dṛṣṭa (seen), adṛṣṭa (unseen), and phala (fruit); neuter nominative singular
sarva (all) with abhīṣṭa (desired); neuter nominative singular
adjective modifying the fruit; neuter nominative singular
optative of bhū (to become); third person singular

items.question: What fruits are obtained by performing Durga worship on Mahanavami and Kartika full moon?
premises: Durga worship on Mahanavami and Kartika full moon yields fruit.
Seen and unseen desired fruits become easily obtained.
items.inference: Therefore the rite grants every desired seen and unseen fruit without difficulty.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: All desired fruits, seen and unseen, become easily obtained.
